subject: general
question: As on February 2024, who among the following is the Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarbananda Sonowal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarbananda Sonowal** is the **Union Minister for Ports, Shipping, and Waterways** as of February 2024.
 
• He is also responsible for the **Ministry of AYUSH**, which focuses on traditional medicine and alternative healthcare systems.
 
• Previously, he served as the **Chief Minister of Assam** from 2016 to 2021, where he played a significant role in state governance and development.
 
• He is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and represents the **Majuli constituency** in Assam.
 
• Under his leadership, the Ministry of Ports, Shipping, and Waterways has been actively working on initiatives such as the **Sagar Mala Project**, which aims to modernize India's ports and improve logistics.
 
• The Ministry is also focusing on the development of **inland waterways** to enhance connectivity and reduce transportation costs.
 
• Sarbananda Sonowal has been a strong advocate for sustainable development in the maritime sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Giriraj Singh**__

 __
 
• **Giriraj Singh** is the **Union Minister for Rural Development and Panchayati Raj.**
 
• He has been actively working towards the implementation of rural development schemes like the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).**
 
• He represents the **Begusarai constituency** in Bihar and is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
 
 
• **Prahlad Joshi**__
 __
 
• **Prahlad Joshi** is the** Union Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution & New and Renewable Energy**.
 
• He has been focusing on the effective management of India's **coal reserves** and ensuring smooth parliamentary proceedings.
 
• He represents the **Dharwad constituency** in Karnataka.
 
 
 
• **Hardeep Singh Puri**__
 
 
• **Hardeep Singh Puri** is the **Union Minister for Petroleum and Natural Gas** and **Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs.**
 
• He has been instrumental in implementing urban development projects like the **Smart Cities Mission** and **PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana).**
 
• He has also played a key role in ensuring India's energy security and promoting **clean energy initiatives.**
